column1: # The two SCF iteration rows that the engine printed for job H2-A-01, plotted and shown by tools/render_h2_scf_rows.py.
# Every row field is the engine's own printed string, copied from results/h2/H2-A-01-run-01/redacted/psi4-output.dat
# (lines 151, 153 and 154). Nothing is rounded, converted, relabelled or derived. The third column is RMS |[F,P]|,
# the engine's own label; it is not a density difference. The engine printed no iteration 0 row, and this table has no more rows.
# The plot draws the ABSOLUTE VALUE of the printed, signed Delta E (a postprocessing transformation: the minus sign of each
# printed string is removed; nothing else is derived) on a logarithmic axis, at iterations 1 and 2 only.
# The optional guide row is the recorded E_CONVERGENCE setting, drawn as a labelled reference line only.
# Columns: row, label, total_energy, delta_e, rms_fp, trailer, source. The header row carries the printed column labels.
